tips_en: Start with Paper 1 (strong-to-weak test-time scaffolding) — its +42.3% accuracy uplift on ToM benchmarks and the insight that gains come from offloading reasoning into deterministic code rather than eliciting more chain-of-thought are immediately actionable. Papers 1 and 3 form a natural pairing: they attack the same goal (boosting weaker model performance) from opposite ends — Paper 1 avoids training entirely via inference-time harnesses, while Paper 3 improves the model itself through unsupervised self-distillation using only the model's own majority-vote consensus. Paper 2 (Spark-to-Paper) is a practical companion read, as its integrity gates and composable skill design echo Paper 1's emphasis on separating deterministic checks from model judgment.
tips_zh: 建议先读论文1（强到弱的测试时脚手架）——其在ToM基准上+42.3%的准确率提升，以及"增益来自将推理卸载到确定性代码而非激发更多思维链"的洞察非常实用。论文1和论文3构成天然的对照阅读：它们从相反方向攻克同一目标（提升弱模型表现）——论文1完全通过推理时脚手架避免训练，论文3则利用模型自身的多数投票共识通过无监督自蒸馏改进模型本身。论文2（Spark-to-Paper）作为实践性补充阅读，其完整性门控和可组合技能设计呼应了论文1中"将确定性检查与模型判断分离"的核心思想。
